evaluator: Codex current session, independent of the local Qwen generator; reference-based model review, not the paper GPT-5 judge
candidate_text: answer.answer only; failed generation has null rubric scores and remains in completion denominator.
aggregation: Mean of per-answer dimension sums, per repository means, same-question paired differences; repository-cluster bootstrap for delta. Failed generation remains in completion denominator with null rubric scores; conditional score denominator is explicit.
source_checks: Repository source checked for concrete failures and ambiguous references. No official gold source spans; no gold Recall@K claim. All 20 questions and failures remain in primary denominator.
label_masking: Condition names and retrieval metadata hidden during initial scoring of new30 answers; same orchestrator can access raw records, so partial masking, not independent blinded review.
duplicate_candidate_policy: Identical answer text for the same question across new30 conditions reuses the first assigned scores. Old20 grades reused verbatim with provenance.
cohorts: Old20, new30 and combined50 reported separately.
